info.title: The Pandit API
info.description:
Versioned REST/JSON gateway for The Pandit platform. Clients (web, iOS, Android, admin) call this service exclusively — domain services are never exposed directly.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT in the Authorization header.

**Tiers:** basic < silver < gold. Gated endpoints return 403 when the caller's tier is insufficient.

get.description: Returns the full Panchang for the requested date and location. Served from the edge/in-process cache — typical p99 < 50 ms on cache hit.
Returns Panchang for every day in the requested month. Requires Silver tier.

DailyPanchangOut.title: DailyPanchangOut
DailyPanchangOut.description: Full Panchang for one (date, location, settings) — the primary API payload.
